items.title: How Intuit migrated from Apache Hive Metastore to AWS Glue Data Catalog
items.summary: How Intuit migrated its data catalog from Apache Hive Metastore to AWS Glue Data Catalog on its journey to an open, secure lakehouse. This post covers the challenges, the phased bidirectional-sync solution, and the benefits: reduced operational overhead, improved data discovery, and tighter integration with AWS analytics services.
items.creator: Srinivasan Krishnasamy
